title: A Concise Bounded Description
description: One Instance, the Work it instantiates, and the resources they name, in a single document.
$comment:
A CBD is an array of resources and not a different kind of thing, so this is an envelope and nothing more: each member is checked by dialect.json, exactly as a resource on its own would be. Written by hand rather than generated, because there is nothing here to derive.

Two differences from a stored record, neither of which needs saying. bf:hasInstance and bf:instanceOf embed the whole node rather than holding a bare URI, because the other resource is in the document -- and the dialect already allows that, since a reference is open and an embedded resource is a reference carrying more. And a description node keeps no @id: framing several resources at once makes a processor label them, and those labels address nothing outside the document, which the dialect already forbids.

The reference to dialect.json is relative, so it resolves against wherever these are served from, and the definitions exist in one place rather than two.

@graph.description: The resources described, each a Work, Instance, Hub or Item.
